question: A man sells two articles at Rs. 9,180 each. He gains 8% on one article and loses 15% on the other. His overall profit or loss is:
solution:
Given:

SP of each article = Rs. 9,180

He gains 8% on one article and loses 15% on the other.

Concept used:

SP = CP - CP × Loss%

SP = CP + CP × Gain%

Loss = CP - SP

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the first and second article be P and Q.

According to the question,

⇒ P + P × 8% = 9180&
